login.heroTagline: Free sports attendance tracking app available in multiple languages.
login.heroTitle: Free users, advertising managed by you.
login.heroDesc: Clubs, coaches, staff, players and coordination use Sportia list for free.The Master login allows you to see everything and manage the model with advertising spaces.
login.title: Choose how to sign in
login.demoKeys: The demo keys are {staffKey} for Coach/Manager and {coordKey} for Coordination.Master uses {masterKey}.

login.playerDesc: The player will only be able to see his individual record and the ranking.

hero.title: Manage your sports club in one place.
hero.description: Sportia list organizes players, attendance, sports, divisions, rankings and reports with role-based access and club-separated data.
hero.playerCardDesc: You entered as a player.You only have access to your individual file and the public ranking.
banner.title: Attendance, players, divisions and rankings organized.
banner.desc: Each institution works with its own data, roles and sports to manage training sessions and reports without mixing clubs.
ad.administered: {size} · Managed by the owner of Sportia list
ad.hero.title: Sobre Rieles Vagon
ad.sidebar.title: Side advertising
ad.footer.title: Bottom advertising

master.googleAds.title: Google AdSense
master.title: Global Dashboard
master.desc: The Master role sees everything that Coach/Manager, Coordination and players do.This panel brings together statistics, user reports and advertising spaces.
profile.desc: This view is individual: the player only sees his own chip and the public ranking.
ranking.title: Ranking by attendance and commitment
ranking.desc: Visible to all users.Sort players who share litter, age or team, adding 10 pts for training, 10 pts for matches, 10 pts for travel/tour, 20 pts if staying and 20 pts if hosting/receiving.
ops.attendance.title: Training or match control
ops.attendance.desc: All players start as present.The operator only marks absentees as appropriate to the training or selected match.
ops.tours.title: Tour control
ops.tours.desc: For tours, mark who travels, who stays overnight and who receives players.
data.title: Register player details
data.desc: Choose bulk upload with Excel/CSV or manual entry player by player. Everything stays saved in the local roster.
import.title: Excel/CSV spreadsheet upload
import.desc: Upload each spreadsheet you have: the system bulk-processes and imports player data, activity, category, team and cohort.
import.excelDesc: Supports Last name, First name, Full name, ID, Activity, Activity Category, Category, Team and more. Minimum: full name or last name and first name.
import.noValidRows: No valid rows found. Each row must have last name and first name.
import.missingColumns: The spreadsheet must include Last name and First name columns (any case).
import.skipped: {count} row(s) were skipped due to incomplete data.
import.fileError: The form could not be read.Verify that it is Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV compatible.
message.saveRequired: Complete last name, first name, ID and sport to upload the registration.
table.confirmDelete: Delete {count} player(s)? You can undo afterwards.
table.confirmDeleteAll: Delete all {count} players visible for this sport?
report.title: Example of attendance report
report.desc: This example shows how Sportia list can measure attendance per athlete or generally for an entire division, team or class.
report.summary.label: Report
report.medal.title: {count} players with medal
report.medal.desc: The medal is assigned when the player completes 30 days without absences on his record.
report.note: Example: if you choose a sport, the entire graph is recalculated for that sport.If you also choose Individual, show an athlete;with Division, Team or Litter, shows the consolidated of the selected group.
panel.title: First module ready to connect real data.
panel.desc: This base prepares the main experience: recording attendance, viewing indicators and ordering training by sport or team.
